name: uber-eat-habits
description: Extension Chrome pour retrouver les restaurants et les dernières commandes Uber Eats.

scripts.check: node --check scripts/check-chrome-store-credentials.mjs && node --check src/api-interceptor.js && node --check src/api-client.js && node --check src/orders.js && node --check src/ratings.js && node --check src/ui.js && node --check src/content.js && node scripts/check-extension.mjs && npm run typecheck
scripts.api:generate: dotnet tool restore && dotnet nswag run api.config.nswag && tsc --project tsconfig.api.json
